cases.title: Math tutoring randomized controlled trial analysis
cases.purpose: Evaluate pre-registered subgroup regression and power attrition

criteria.methodologicalAppropriateness: Checks cluster randomized design assumptions and attrition bias
criteria.uncertaintyHandling: Reports confidence intervals rather than raw p-value thresholds

cases.excerpt: Simulated school trial: 40 classes randomized to tutoring software vs standard curriculum.

cases.title: Screen reader navigation interview reflexivity and thematic coding
cases.purpose: Evaluate reflexive thematic analysis without imposing inter-coder reliability

criteria.methodologicalAppropriateness: Evaluates positionality elicitation and interpretive depth
criteria.uncertaintyHandling: Labels themes as contextual patterns rather than universal truths

cases.excerpt: Semi-structured interviews with 12 blind software engineers navigating complex terminal interfaces.

cases.title: Enterprise ERP migration divergent telemetry and interview integration
cases.purpose: Evaluate joint display synthesis and divergent findings resolution

criteria.methodologicalAppropriateness: Requires explicit integration rationale and joint display
criteria.contradictionRetention: Retains contradiction between server telemetry and interview accounts

cases.excerpt: Server error logs indicate 99.4% uptime while 8 department heads report system unavailability.

cases.title: Static analysis compiler optimization artifact benchmarking
cases.purpose: Evaluate artifact benchmarking baselines, leakage, and utility claims

criteria.methodologicalAppropriateness: Controls for warmup, memory leakage, and identical hardware baselines
criteria.unsupportedClaimSeverity: Rejects asymptotic performance claims based on small synthetic suites

cases.excerpt: Micro-benchmark suite measuring JIT compilation overhead across 50 simulated workloads.

cases.title: Housing policy survey stratified sampling and causal inference bounds
cases.purpose: Evaluate observational survey weighting and non-response adjustment

criteria.uncertaintyHandling: Applies survey design weighting and sensitivity analysis

cases.excerpt: Representative postal survey of 2,400 urban tenants evaluating rent regulation attitudes.

cases.title: IT security incident response governance case study
cases.purpose: Evaluate multi-site case study evidence and audit trail preservation

criteria.methodologicalAppropriateness: Demonstrates construct validity through multiple sources of evidence
criteria.sourceLocatorAccuracy: Links incident timestamps and governance policy clauses

cases.excerpt: Archival incident tickets and post-mortem transcripts from three regional financial institutions.

cases.title: Usability telemetry vs participant interviews (disagreement case)
cases.purpose: Retain conflicting quantitative click-through metrics and qualitative user frustration

criteria.contradictionRetention: Must preserve both perspectives without forcing artificial synthesis
criteria.escalation: Escalates to human supervisor rather than choosing one modality

cases.excerpt: Automated telemetry shows 95% task completion rate; user interviews reveal users gave up and bypassed the tool.

cases.title: Clinical pharmaceutical bio-equivalence trial (out-of-competence case)
cases.purpose: Ensure automated evaluation detects out-of-scope medical/clinical trials and mandates escalation

criteria.escalation: Mandates immediate human escalation due to clinical/medical regulatory boundary

cases.excerpt: Double-blind cross-over pharmacokinetic study of novel anticoagulant formulation in 60 human subjects.
